request.style: English, Armenian sacred chant, a mixed choir and a tenor soloist, duduk melody over a drone, ancient modal harmony, evening stone church, warm and quiet, 62 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They drew near the village where they were going
And he acted as though he would go farther
But they urged him strongly
Stay with us, for it is evening

[Chorus]
Stay with us, Lord, for it is evening
And the day is now far spent

[Verse]
He took the bread and blessed it
He broke it and gave it to them
Their eyes were opened and they knew him
And he vanished from their sight

[Chorus]
Stay with us, Lord, for it is evening
And the day is now far spent

[Outro]
Did not our hearts burn within us
